## Testing

### Coverage note
This project aims for **≥ 50 % test coverage**.  If your change adds or
modifies library functions, please consider adding or updating tests in
`src/tests/`.  Coverage is reported automatically in CI — you can check
the coverage summary in the "Build and run unit tests" step of the workflow.

Reviewers may ask for tests, but coverage is **not a hard merge requirement**.

## Checklist
- [ ] Code builds without warnings (`make`)
- [ ] Existing tests still pass (`make check`)
- [ ] New/changed functions have at least a basic test (encouraged, not required)
